| cli, human TTY | 0.2 | Static k9s-style fixed-column rows and one static context header. Colour is only a second cue: amber `DIALOG` and dim `stale`, always beside the word. Nothing redraws in place and there are no spinners. |

text: | cli, `--json` / non-TTY / `NO_COLOR` / `TERM=dumb` / `viola run` passthrough | 0.0 | No colour, no glyphs, no cursor control, no spinner. `viola run` prints nothing at all while the wrapped `claude` TUI runs, and neither does a `viola revive` that passed its preflight. |
